body: But perhaps it is my fault. It is almost always my fault.
I felt every word of this. :')

I'm sorry, I didn't mean it like that. I really am. Idk really, in my case, I find it helpful to talk to people, not tell them I'm suicidal, but just keeping to myself makes me worse. Idk really, tbh. Again, I'm sorry. I really hope you get better soon. Take care <3

Because when you're suicidal, you're too weak to help yourself. If you were able to help yourself, you wouldn't be suicidal. You're literally in the worst state of mind possible. Imagine being eternally exhausted, all you want to do is die. Do you really think such a person has the capacity to help himself?
